DIWA Spatial Hub
Immersive digital twin of the DIWA supersites

Welcome to the early demo version of the DIWA Spatial Hub!

I am developing the DIWA Spatial Hub as an immersive virtual environment designed to bring the DIWA supersites together in one shared virtual hall. With this early demo, I aim to explore and test some of its key features, including virtual navigation, voice-enabled collaborative meetings, the AI companion, and performance across web browsers and VR headsets. Please note that the landscapes and data currently displayed on the tables are illustrative and intended for demonstration purposes. In the final version, I plan to integrate DSM-based elevation models and actual measured data from the DIWA supersites. I would greatly appreciate your feedback, ideas, and recommendations to help me further improve and develop the experience. Please feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions with me directly.
